title: docs(changeset): stop the pending 8499 entry publishing a stale registry size
body:
Fixes #9704

Clause-②: no

`.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md` is pending and unconsumed, so `changeset version` copies its body verbatim into the CHANGELOG. It stated a RENDERER REGISTRY size of 656 twice — and the second occurrence said "re-measured here", claiming its own freshness. A false reading that asserts it was just measured is the expensive kind: it forecloses the check a bare citation would invite.

## What I measured, and on which instrument

The entry's two sentences name two different consumers of ONE derivation, and that had to be established before any number could be corrected:

- `check:doc-types` (`scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`) judges `type` literals against `deriveRegistryKeys`, and prints the size of that key set in its own summary line.
- `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` (`packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`) is the generated snapshot `objectui check` uses, regenerated from that same derivation — `scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs` says so under its own heading "One derivation, two consumers".

Measured at `396a1c198` — today's `origin/main`, this branch's base:

| instrument | reading |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, summary line | **649** registered keys |
| distinct quoted entries in `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` | **649** |

Two independent readers of the same derivation agree, and 656 is produced by neither.

Controls, because neither a bare zero nor a bare agreement proves anything on its own:

- **Lit control on the derivation, same corpus.** Appending one `ComponentRegistry.register('zzlitcontrolkey', …)` call to `packages/app-shell/src/views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx` moved the printed reading from 649 to **650**, and resolved call sites from 233 to 234. Reverted; restore proven by blob-hash equality and by `git diff --name-only HEAD` listing only the changeset.
- **Lit and absent controls on the snapshot.** `ui:page` and `metric-card` read present; a nonsense key reads absent.
- **Lit control on `check:changeset-no-major`.** Flipping this entry's frontmatter to `major` turned it red, exit 1. Reverted, hash-verified.
- **Lit control on `check:changeset-presence`.** With the temporary source edit in the tree it went red, exit 1, naming one released package. Green again once reverted.

## Why no number replaces 656

Triage was explicit that 644 and 649 must not be written in: they are today's readings of a moving population and they would rot exactly as 656 did. AGENTS.md's ninth commandment is the standing form of the same rule — point at the instrument that re-derives the claim, and never write down its answer. So both sentences now name the instrument and carry no count, and nothing I wrote asserts a measurement of its own.

## Exact before and after

Sentence one.

BEFORE

> It was invisible because `check:doc-types` judges a `type` literal against the
> RENDERER REGISTRY (656 keys) and not against `AnyComponentSchema` (107 arm literals).
> The two faces disagreed by construction and nothing compared them at a node slot.

AFTER

> It was invisible because `check:doc-types` judges a `type` literal against the
> RENDERER REGISTRY — the key set whose size that gate prints in its own summary
> line — and not against `AnyComponentSchema`. The two faces disagreed by
> construction and nothing compared them at a node slot.

Sentence two.

BEFORE

> Its `check-validity-recogniser` suite measured 658 registered types against 102 arm
> literals when it was written; re-measured here it is 656 against 154, so the
> "registered but not modelled" bucket goes from 558 to 505 and its fixture moved off
> the HTML primitives (they are modelled now) onto `metric-card`, whose absence from the
> union is ruled rather than pending.

AFTER

> Its `check-validity-recogniser` suite measured 658 registered types against 102 arm
> literals when it was written; no replacement figure is copied in here, because a
> count written into a published entry is re-derived by nothing afterwards — read
> the two sides off `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` and `AnyComponentSchema` themselves. The
> literals armed here are registered types that now have a member, so they leave the
> "registered but not modelled" bucket. Its fixture moved off the HTML primitives
> (they are modelled now) onto `metric-card`, whose absence from the union is ruled
> rather than pending.

## What I deliberately did NOT change

- **The `(107 arm literals)` parenthetical was dropped at the first site, but `taking the union from 107 to 154` two paragraphs below stays.** The distinction is what the figure describes. A reading of the TREE's registry rots under a published entry; a reading of THIS DELIVERY's own diff — four arms, 47 literals, the union movement it performed — does not, because the diff is immutable. The first site's parenthetical was a present-tense count of a live union, and it is restated properly as a delta just below, so dropping it loses nothing.
- **`658 … 102 … when it was written`** stays. It is explicitly dated and framed as a past reading of the suite, which is the legitimate form. Triage did not flag it, and I have no evidence it is false.
- **`558`** went out with `505`: it appeared only as the left end of the false `558 to 505` movement.
- **Frontmatter is byte-identical.** `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` prints `declared at base: @object-ui/types: minor` and `declares now: @object-ui/types: minor`, and reports the file as its own case 2 — a deliberate correction. That is the expected shape, not a problem.
- Nothing else in the body was touched. The rest is the true record of that delivery.

## Gates, at `be0700352`

| gate | exit | verdict it printed |
|---|---|---|
| `check-changeset-presence` | 0 | no changeset owed; no released source moved |
| `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 | no changeset declares a major bump |
| `check-changeset-overwrite` | 0 | 1 modified, reported as case 2, report-only |
| `check-changeset-fixed` | 0 | all workspace packages in the fixed group |
| `check-changeset-claims` | 0 | no pending changeset names a file this change touches |
| `check-pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | no test source names a pending changeset |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` | 0 | 0 new citations, enforcement report-only |
| `check-doc-component-types` | 0 | every documented component type is registered |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` | 0 | NOT GOVERNED; ordinary review and merge-queue route |
| control-character self-scan | 1, no match | no control bytes in the file |

Exit codes were captured to disk before any pipe.

## Found here, deliberately not done here

`packages/cli/src/__tests__/check-validity-recogniser.test.ts` carries the SAME stale figures in a source comment beside the `metric-card` fixture — 656 registered types, 154 arm literals, 505 with no member — introduced there as "Re-measured on this tree". That comment is where this entry's sentence came from. It is outside this card's declared surface (prose only, this changeset file only, no source file moves) and it does not publish verbatim, so it is not on the release deadline. Reported for a card of its own rather than repaired here. Dedup terms: `check-validity-recogniser` · `metric-card fixture count` · `Re-measured on this tree` · `known-schema-types count` · `505 registered types`.
